questions.q: P is any point inside the rectangle ABCD. If PA = 85 cm, PB = 65 cm and PC = 5 cm, then the length of PD (in cm) is equal to:
questions.explain:
For any point P inside a rectangle ABCD, the sum of the squares of distances to opposite vertices are equal: $PA^2 + PC^2 = PB^2 + PD^2$.
Substitute the values: $85^2 + 5^2 = 65^2 + PD^2$.
$7225 + 25 = 4225 + PD^2$
$7250 = 4225 + PD^2$
$PD^2 = 7250 - 4225 = 3025$
$PD = \sqrt{3025} = 55$ cm.
